description: List the viewer's tasks (Relay connection), optionally filtered by team, user, status, archived state, or a text query. Paginate with `first` + the `after` DateTime cursor. Parabol GraphQL: viewer.tasks. Requires TASKS_READ.

after.description: DateTime cursor for the next (older) page (the last edge's cursor).

statusFilters.description: Filter by task status (TaskStatusEnum: active, stuck, done, future).

userIds.description: Filter to tasks assigned to these user ids.

name: list_tasks
title: List tasks
